The absence of symptoms, lack of rapid growth, and non-hypertrophic morphology further support a low-risk, stable AK rather than an evolving invasive malignancy. No red flags (e.g., induration, ulceration, rapid enlargement, bleeding) suggest higher-risk features.

[DIAGNOSIS]  
Actinic keratosis
